Part 2 · How to build assets

Property progression, in one picture

Live in your asset while it works. At 65, right-size to a 3-room flat (~$500,000) and unlock the difference as retirement funds. Pick a property — or drag to your own number.

$1,500,000 Your property at age 65
Right-size: 3-room flat $500K

unlocked at 65 for retirement — on top of still owning a fully paid home.

Assumes right-sizing to a 3-room flat costing about $500,000 at age 65. Property values assumed to hold, not to grow — any appreciation is upside on top of this.

The real cost of not planning

What if we don't retire well?

The shortfall doesn't disappear —it lands on the people you love.

At 91, still working 12-hour shifts at ION Orchard. Whatever his reasons, the picture stops you — because a retirement without a plan can look like this.

Planning isn't about fear. It's about keeping the choice yours.

You

Work longer, downgrade the home, and stretch every dollar in the years meant for rest.

Your spouse

Shares the worry and the sacrifice — a thinner, tighter retirement for two.

Your children

The "sandwich generation" — funding your old age instead of building their own.

Retiring well isn't for you alone — it's for them.
